## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The helper works for ASCII titles, but it silently drops non-ASCII letters, even though the PR description says it replaces "non-alphanumeric characters". This should be fixed before merge. Separately, AGENTS.md:4 requires a `## Testing` section in every pull-request description, and this PR's body doesn't have one.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — `title.lower()` runs before the ASCII-only class `[^a-z0-9]+`, so `slugify("Café Menu")` returns `"caf-menu"`, `slugify("Über uns")` returns `"ber-uns"`, and `slugify("日本語")` returns `""`. Python's `str.isalnum()` treats these letters as alphanumeric, which is what the PR description promises. Would you either transliterate first (e.g. `unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()` before the substitution) or switch to `re.sub(r"[\W_]+", "-", title.lower())`? Whichever you choose, please add a parametrized case for a non-ASCII title. — Page titles that aren't English get mangled URLs. Titles written entirely in non-Latin scripts all map to the empty slug, so their page URLs collide or end up blank.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Both new modules start with a docstring, as AGENTS.md:3 requires.
- The parametrized tests cover the trimming and run-collapsing behaviour the description claims: `"  Already--hyphenated  "` → `"already-hyphenated"`. They also cover the all-separator input `"---"` and the empty string.
